notes: Rover parking spot for the 'With rover' version of each EVA. Nigel picks each spot (flat, near the stops, reachable by rover on slopes up to about 15°) and fills in spot and drive_distance_m. Positions are projected metres (Mars 2000 equidistant cylindrical), like scenarios.json. Mia then runs: node src/safezone/buildRoverHomeFiles.js (home file, home = the rover) and node src/safezone/checkEvaVersions.js (safety checks for both versions). spot null = not chosen yet. EVA-08 uses the existing G2 staging point.

rules.note: Open rover with suits on: drives count against the 8 h suit and the 2 h reserve stays protected. Storm plan: back to the rover, then drive home. The rover is not a storm shelter.
